title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly positioned as world simulators, it is essential to evaluate whether their videos conform to physical commonsense. However, existing benchmarks rely on annotators who rate each video with a single score based on intuition, yielding ratings that are subjective and do not tell which physical principle is violated. We introduce PhyRubric, a rubric-grounded diagnostic framework for evaluating physical commonsense in T2V generation. For each caption, PhyRubric constructs a caption-specific rubric before any video is seen, decomposing the caption into semantic and physical items, and derives scores from item-level verdicts grounded in timestamped evidence. We instantiate this framework as PhyRubric-Bench, which spans 34 categories across five physical domains, and scale it up to PhyRubric-Train with 3,788 videos, on which we fine-tune the open-source PhyRubric-Judge. translated_title: PhyRubric：基于评分准则的文本到视频生成中物理常识的诊断性评估
translated_abstract: 随着文本到视频（T2V）模型日益被定位为世界模拟器，评估其生成的视频是否符合物理常识变得至关重要。然而，现有的基准评测依赖于标注者凭直觉为每个视频打出一个单一分数，这种评分方式主观性强，且无法指出视频究竟违反了哪一条物理原理。我们提出了 PhyRubric，一个以评分准则为基础的、用于评估 T2V 生成中物理常识的诊断性评估框架。对于每条文本描述，PhyRubric 在观看任何视频之前先构建针对该描述的评分准则，将描述分解为语义条目和物理条目，并基于带时间戳证据的条目级判定来推导最终分数。我们将该框架实例化为 PhyRubric-Bench，涵盖五个物理领域的 34 个类别，并将其扩展为包含 3,788 个视频的 PhyRubric-Train 数据集，在该数据集上微调得到开源的 PhyRubric-Judge 评测模型。在十个（模型上的）实证结果表明……
tldr: 提出基于评分准则的诊断性评估框架 PhyRubric，在观看视频前为每条描述构建专属评分准则并分解为语义与物理条目，再基于时间戳证据进行条目级判定，从而可解释地评估文本到视频模型是否符合物理常识。
en_tdlr: PhyRubric is a rubric-grounded diagnostic framework that evaluates physical commonsense in text-to-video generation by constructing caption-specific rubrics with semantic and physical items and deriving scores from timestamped, item-level verdicts.
